mapper.sql: select q.question_id, q.question_code, q.content, q.options, q.correct_answer, q.subject_id, q.question_type, q.difficulty, q.analysis, q.content_hash, q.status, q.del_flag, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark, q.stem_image, q.options_image, q.answer_image, q.analysis_image, q.source_year, q.source_region, q.source_exam, s.subject_name, (select count(1) from spas_qb_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_id = q.question_id) as knowledge_count from spas_qb_question q left join spas_subject s on q.subject_id = s.subject_id
mapper.select: where q.subject_id = #{subjectId} and q.content_hash = #{contentHash} and q.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into spas_qb_question( question_code, content, options, correct_answer, subject_id, question_type, difficulty, analysis, content_hash, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark, stem_image, options_image, answer_image, analysis_image, source_year, source_region, source_exam ) values ( #{questionCode}, #{content}, #{options}, #{correctAnswer}, #{subjectId}, #{questionType}, #{difficulty}, #{analysis}, #{contentHash}, #{status}'0', '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark}, #{stemImage}, #{optionsImage}, #{answerImage}, #{analysisImage}, #{sourceYear}, #{sourceRegion}, #{sourceExam} )
mapper.select: select qk.id, qk.question_id, qk.knowledge_id, qk.weight, qk.is_primary, k.knowledge_name from spas_qb_question_knowledge qk left join spas_knowledge k on qk.knowledge_id = k.knowledge_id where qk.question_id = #{questionId} order by qk.is_primary desc, qk.id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into spas_qb_question_knowledge(question_id, knowledge_id, weight, is_primary) values
(#{item.questionId}, #{item.knowledgeId}, #{item.weight}, #{item.isPrimary}'0')
insert into spas_qb_ai_suggest_log(question_id, request_json, response_json, adopted, create_by, create_time) values(#{questionId}, #{requestJson}, #{responseJson}, #{adopted}, #{createBy}, now())
